scope.purpose: auxiliary held-out matched-Gaussian early gate only
scope.claim_boundary: A kill rejects this fixed shallow d16 two-stage BSQ training recipe; it is not a converse for arbitrary nonlinear codebooks. A survival does not authorize opening the pinned panel because no frozen auxiliary gate-role source exists.

data.normalization: per-matrix FP16 mean and centered RMS; score in original coordinates
data.gaussian_control: iid Gaussian from pooled training-role mean and centered RMS, then the identical per-matrix FP16 normalization path
data.file_rule: directory must contain exactly l15e{expert}_{up|down}.bf16.bin for the frozen expert set and no other BF16 source files

codec.encoder: Linear(16,64)-SiLU-Linear(64,18), training and code inference only
codec.decoder_evaluation_dtype: FP16 round-trip parameters with FP32 accumulation
codec.code_packing: 36 bits per 16 weights, dense with no per-chunk padding

optimization.paired_rule: Qwen and Gaussian use identical parameter initialization, batch indices, update count, temperature, optimizer, evaluation steps, and bit-flip search

evaluation.fold_unit: whole validation expert pooled over up and down

early_kill.upper_bound: pooled s_match plus two whole-expert standard errors
early_kill.note: At the strict boundaries, 0.08 + 6*0.01 = 0.14, below both the production 0.1613464 and six-expert 0.1687065 matched-s requirements. This is a preregistered trend kill, not a mathematical upper bound.
